changed_factor: Heading actions choose an offset from the observed goal bearing instead of cumulative heading increments.
physical_noise_caveat: The same normalized Gaussian standard deviation means 4.5-degree offset noise instead of 2.25-degree increment noise before aircraft dynamics.
required_validation: Four support configurations must preserve observations, native rewards, terminals and metrics against equivalent direct bearing commands.
limitations: One-seed development screen, not generalization. Mapping-induced navigation is not learned progress. Unseen streams remain reserved.
